note: Candidate draft produced by Agent 11. Arabic is deliberately NOT on the P01/1 language menu (T-0009); it ships so that RTL layout can be exercised against real strings with dir="rtl" lang="ar". Attesting it would not put it on the menu, because the menu is the design-sourced list intersected with readiness and Arabic is not in that list.

passthroughRationale.app.name: Product name. It is spelled the same in every locale.
passthroughRationale.tokens.sample.text: A typographic specimen, not prose. It already mixes Yoruba, Hausa and Igbo glyphs on purpose, and translating it would destroy what it tests.
passthroughRationale.tokens.sample.arabic: An Arabic script specimen shown to prove the Arabic webfont renders. Translating it would defeat the point.
